title: agent-tools model manifest
description: Shape of lib/contracts/models.yaml — the ecosystem's single source of truth for the current-best concrete model per provider, each tagged with capabilities (esp. `vision`), plus a symbolic roles/aliases map. The `vision` role/alias resolving only to vision-capable entries is a CROSS-REFERENCE the JSON-Schema cannot express; the checker's --validate enforces it.

version.description: Manifest schema version. Only v1 is defined.

models.description: The concrete model pins. Within a provider, strongest/preferred first.

roles.description: Symbolic lens (architect/fast/code/reasoning/vision/...) -> a concrete model id present in `models`. `vision` MUST resolve to a vision-capable entry (checker --validate enforces).

aliases.description: Convenience names + the `<provider>:latest` pointers -> a concrete model id present in `models`.

fallback_chain.description: The agent-facing, cross-harness resilience order read by every harness (cc/codex/oc/pi/omp). Priority order: on the Nth repeated model error the live executor drops to the next entry, and returns to the top once the preferred one recovers. `harness` is the EXECUTOR boundary (a model swap when it equals the running harness, a re-dispatch when it differs), not the closed `provider` enum.

harness.description: The executor boundary: which harness runs this step (e.g. claude, oc, codex, pi). NOT the closed model-board provider enum — harness names are tool wiring.

model.description: The concrete model id passed to that harness's own model selector (e.g. fable, opus, GLM-5.2, gpt5.5).

notation.description: Human-readable `<harness>:<model>` label for surfacing the active step (optional).

capability.description: Closed capability set. `vision` is load-bearing for the image-review filter (#3681).

id.description: Concrete, provider-resolvable model string. Never a symbolic alias.

provider.description: Transport provider the checker can poll for a model list.

capabilities.description: What the model can do. Omit `vision` for models without real image input (e.g. Kimi-K2.7-Code).

context.description: Advertised input context window in tokens (optional).
